body.value: 藩制一覧表第七（重原）
藩制一覧表（はんせいいちらんひょう）第七（重原）

Running header: 'Survey of Domain Institutions, Fascicle 7 — (Shigehara)'. This is PROVENANCE, printed in the top margin of every leaf, and it names the fascicle the leaf was bound into, not necessarily the domain of the data below. Here they agree. 第七 is a fascicle number, not a data theme; fascicles 1-7 carry the civil and economic tables.
藩制一覧表第七（重原）
百四十八
百四十八（ひゃくよんじゅうはち）＝148
Printed book-page number 148, set in the bottom margin of the right-hand leaf. A page label, not data.
百四十八
○重原藩
重原藩（しげはらはん）

Shigehara domain. The ○ opens the entry: everything printed to the LEFT of this marker belongs to Shigehara, everything to the right would belong to the preceding domain. Here nothing stands to its right but the running header and the printed page number, so this leaf carries no preceding domain's overflow — it is a single-domain page.
○重原藩
三河國碧海加茂設樂幡豆四郡ノ內八十八ヶ村
三河国（みかわのくに）碧海（あおみ）・加茂（かも）・設楽（したら）・幡豆（はず）四郡の内 八十八ヶ村

Territorial note under the marker: 'Mikawa province — 88 villages within the four districts of Aomi, Kamo, Shitara and Hazu.' Set as a warichu (double-column inline note): the RIGHT sub-column reads 三河國碧海加茂設樂幡 and the LEFT continues 豆四郡ノ內八十八ヶ村 — the district name 幡豆 splits across the pair, which confirms the right-then-left reading order. Shigehara was a jin'ya (office-seat) domain with scattered village holdings rather than a castle and a contiguous block.
重原藩領郡村割注
草高 二萬八千三百五十二石二斗八升五合五勺八才
草高（くさだか）二万八千三百五十二石二斗八升五合五勺八才

Sōdaka — the gross registered yield of the domain: 28,352.28558 koku. This is the headline assessment from which the five 內 deductions below are subtracted to reach the 殘高 (net). Note the page prints plain 二, not the formal 貳; and the sub-koku tail runs 二斗八升五合五勺八才 in strict descending order with no place skipped.
草高
込高共
込高共（こみだかとも）
Qualifier printed at the foot of the 草高 line: 'together with the komidaka' — i.e. the 28,352.28558 koku figure is inclusive of the koku rolled into the assessment, not a bare base figure.
草高込高共注記
五十三石八斗六升三合 加茂郡一野々村之內不足高
五十三石八斗六升三合 — 加茂郡一野々村（かもぐん いちのののむら）の内 不足高

First of five 內 ('of which') deductions from the 草高: 53.863 koku, the shortfall assessed within Ichinono village in Kamo district. The descriptor is a warichu directly beneath the value in the same column slot — RIGHT sub-column 加茂郡一野々, LEFT sub-column 村之內不足高. The page prints 之, not the ニ that the extracted dataset records.
内加茂郡一野々村之内不足高
二十二石壹升九合七勺 社寺院除地
二十二石壹升九合七勺 — 社寺院除地（しゃじいん じょち）

Second 內 deduction: 22.0197 koku of shrine- and temple-exempt land (jochi), removed from the taxable base. The descriptor prints as a single-column warichu (社寺院除地) beneath the value. Note the 斗 place is skipped — the tail reads 壹升九合七勺.
内社寺院除地
二千五百二十一石九斗三合八勺五才 永荒地川欠海成洲入山崩溜地郡ゟ諸引
二千五百二十一石九斗三合八勺五才 — 永荒地（えいこうち）・川欠・海成・洲入、山崩・溜地、郡より諸引

Third and by far the largest 內 deduction: 2,521.90385 koku — 8.9% of the 草高 — written off as permanently ruined ground: eiarechi (permanent waste), river washout, sea encroachment and sandbar inundation; plus landslide and ponded land and sundry district deductions. The descriptor is a two-sub-column warichu beneath the value (RIGHT 永荒地川欠海成洲入, LEFT 山崩溜地郡ゟ諸引). The 升 place is skipped (九斗三合…). Two corrections against the extracted dataset: the koku integer is 二千五百二十一 (2,521, the 一 sits at a pitch-confirmed glyph position), and the particle is the ゟ (yori) ligature, not 乃.
内永荒地川欠海成洲入山崩溜地郡ゟ諸引
二十四石六升七合壹勺四才 陣屋屋鋪地鄉藏地所引
二十四石六升七合壹勺四才 — 陣屋屋鋪地（じんや やしきち）・郷蔵地（ごうぐらち）所引

Fourth 內 deduction: 24.06714 koku deducted for the plots occupied by the domain's own jin'ya (administrative seat and residences) and the village granaries. A small institutional carve-out, exactly as one would expect for a jin'ya domain of this size. Descriptor is a two-sub-column warichu beneath the value (RIGHT 陣屋屋鋪地, LEFT 鄉藏地所引). The 斗 place is skipped.
内陣屋屋鋪地郷藏地所引
二百二十石五斗九升七合八勺九才 無地高
二百二十石五斗九升七合八勺九才 — 無地高（むちだか）

Fifth and last 內 deduction: 220.59789 koku of muchidaka — koku still carried on the register against land that no longer exists on the ground. The descriptor 無地高 is printed directly beneath the value in the same column slot, in full-size type (not a warichu: its glyphs measure 59-64px tall and 66px wide, the same as the value glyphs above it, unlike the genuine half-width warichu on the neighbouring deductions). The five 內 deductions sum to 2,842.45158 koku.
内無地高
殘高 二萬五千五百九石八斗四合
残高（ざんだか）二万五千五百九石八斗四合

Zandaka — the net assessment left after the five 內 deductions: 25,509.804 koku as printed (the 升 place is skipped: 八斗四合). Arithmetic check: 草高 28,352.28558 − 2,842.45158 = 25,509.834, so the printed figure runs 0.03 koku (三升) light. Every component was re-read at single-character magnification and confirmed; the 0.03 gap is a slip in the source, not a transcription error.
殘高
（以下二行原朱書）
（以下二行、原（げん）朱書（しゅがき））

Editorial note in small type: 'the following two lines are written in vermilion in the original'. It announces the next two columns — the 此取米 line and the 內 米…田畑違作用捨引 line — which are bracketed by a parenthesis that opens at the head of the first and closes at the foot of the second. Vermilion in the manuscript typically marks a figure added or checked by a different hand.
以下二行原朱書注記
（此取米九千八百七十七石六升七合六勺二才
（此（この）取米（とりまい）九千八百七十七石六升七合六勺二才

Kono torimai — 'this yields tax rice of' 9,877.06762 koku, the gross tax rice drawn on the 25,509.804 koku net assessment, struck as a five-year average (see the 五ヶ年平均 note at the foot of this column). The 斗 place is skipped (六升七合…). The opening 「（」 here is closed only at the foot of the next column, bracketing the 'two lines' the vermilion note announces. This figure is absent from the extracted dataset.
此取米
五ヶ年平均
五ヶ年平均（ごかねん へいきん）

Note at the foot of the 此取米 column: 'five-year average'. It tells the reader that the 9,877.06762 koku tax-rice figure is not a single year's take but a mean struck over five years — the standard basis for the 1869-70 survey's revenue figures, which smooths harvest variation.
此取米五ヶ年平均注記
內 米千五百六十九石二斗壹升壹合六勺 田畑違作用捨引）
内（うち）米千五百六十九石二斗壹升壹合六勺 — 田畑違作（たはた いさく）用捨引（ようしゃびき）

Of the five-year-average tax rice, 1,569.2116 koku remitted for crop failure on paddy and dry fields (yōsha-biki = a discretionary remission). The 內 is printed small and raised at the head of this line — it belongs to this line, not to a column slot of its own, so it is boxed here. The descriptor is a two-sub-column warichu (RIGHT 田畑違作, LEFT 用捨引) and the 「）」 closing the vermilion bracket sits below it. Check: 9,877.06762 − 1,569.2116 = 8,307.85602 against 正租 + 雜稅 = 8,307.85656 — the identity closes to 0.00054 koku, independently confirming this column and the two to its left.
内田畑違作用捨引
正租 八千百六十八石九斗二升八合壹勺
正租（せいそ）八千百六十八石九斗二升八合壹勺

Seiso — the regular land tax: 8,168.9281 koku, the domain's core revenue and roughly 32% of the 25,509.804 koku net assessment. The ones digit of the koku integer is 八 (two splayed strokes, no top lid) and not 六 (dot-and-lid) — the two glyphs stand three positions apart in this same column for direct comparison; the extracted dataset records 8,166.9281 in error.
正租
雜稅 百三十八石九斗二升八合四勺六才
雑税（ざつぜい）百三十八石九斗二升八合四勺六才

Zatsuzei — miscellaneous taxes: 138.92846 koku, a trivial 1.7% of the regular land tax. On this leaf Shigehara's fiscal base is almost entirely the land tax; the survey records no commercial or product levies of consequence here. The tail reads 八合四勺六才 (verified at 8x); the extracted dataset transposes it to 二勺四才.
雜稅
